product_metadata.title: Hiware 6-Piece Demitasse Espresso Spoons, 4 Inches Stainless Steel Mini Coffee Spoons
features: PREMIUM MATERIAL: The coffee spoon is made of high-quality stainless steel, strong and durable, not easy to bend, anti-corrosion and anti-rust - it is the best mat ch for coffee, More importantly, it is dishwasher safe.
IDEAL SIZE: 4- inch in length, 0.9- inch in width. Perfect size for coffee or tea cups, extra thick ergonomics handle for comfortable grasp.
ELEGANT DESIGN: The spoon has smooth lines, which is a very typical modern design, but its simple and generous style can match the family style of a variety of tableware.

MULTIPLE USE: Perfect for morning coffee, tea, desserts, mousse cake, pudding, ice cream, yogurt, soft boiled eggs, appetizers, condiments, sugar, etc. Also suitable for baby or toddler to use or any other need of a small utensil. Essential for daily use, family gatherings, birthday parties and afternoon tea.
GREAT CHOICE AS A GIFT: This set is an exceptional value and an excellent gift for any occasion. It will be a good choice for you when you want to select a gift.
